name: CHSA First Aid and CPR discount and rebate (Coffs Harbour)
summary: Discounted First Aid and CPR training for SCU Coffs Harbour students, plus member rebates of $30 for CPR and $50 for First Aid.
key: Rebates of $30 for CPR and $50 for First Aid, and a $15 discount through First Aid Mid North Coast.
who: SCU students for the discounted training.
catches: One rebate per student per calendar year, while funds last.

evidence.quote: We've partnered with local providers to help SCU students access discounted First Aid and CPR training.
Book with First Aid Mid North Coast and receive $15 off using the code SCUFIRSTAID at checkout.
